notes: Printed page 219, 'Bilingualism—contd.', Mother-tongue—Tamil. Column order on this page: Kannada, Telugu, Hindustani, Marathi, Banajari, Tulu, Konkani. The mother-tongue figures (cols 2-3) equal the Part I 'Total' of the Tamil group (Tamil + Korama + Koracha, leaf 213), not Part I 'Tamil' alone, for every area. Faint print: leading/trailing 4s often lose their crossbar and look like 1. Eight cells were settled by the printed totals; each is required by both the row check and the State-excl. column check (and, where marked, by the italic figure beneath being larger than the misread upright figure): Bangalore District Kannada upright Females 14,503 (looks 11,503; italic 11,872 beneath); Kolar District Total-of-subsidiary upright Males 14,972 (looks 11,972; italic 12,445); Mysore City Total-of-subsidiary upright Females 4,677 (looks 1,677; italic 4,519); Mysore City Hindustani upright Males 264 (looks 261); Mysore District Telugu upright Females 284 (looks 281); Chitaldrug District Total-of-subsidiary upright Males 2,486 (looks 2,186); Hassan District Total-of-subsidiary upright Females 4,674 (looks 1,671; italic 4,619); Hassan District Telugu upright Females 43 (looks 13; italic 23). With these all checks pass. Hassan District Tulu Females 4 is printed on the upright line with no italic figure.
